tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Diameter Comparison] ↗ thm:conjugate-points-ricci-bounded 1. ch11:11.18

Let $(M,g)$ be a complete, connected Riemannian $n$-manifold satisfying $\operatorname {Rc}(v,v)\geq (n-1)/R^2$ for every unit vector. Then \[ \operatorname {diam}(M)\leq \pi R. \]

Proof

\sketch Completeness and connectedness provide a minimizing geodesic between any two points. Theorem 11.16 bounds its length by $\pi R$.

□
